digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center Transport / Outbound Reconciliation
propositions: Empty assignee string from outbound differ reaches DC transport.update_issue but is not routed to unassign; instead it is passed verbatim to pycontribs JIRA.assign_issue, which treats only None/-1/"-1" as unassign sentinels
Empty string passed to JIRA._get_user_id falls through and calls search_users(user=''), causing either JIRAError or assignment of an arbitrary search result instead of unassigning
DC transport._assign lacks the empty/None routing guard that Cloud transport (acli.py) already implements, replicating the defect pattern of bug 85a1 and bug d067
The fix maps falsy assignee to None in DC transport._assign before calling assign_issue, matching Cloud transport behavior and causing pycontribs to PUT {"name": null} for unassign
Test test_outbound_unassign_round_trips fails RED before the fix; new unit tests verify unassign on empty assignee, rejection of blank strings, and preservation of normal assignment paths
